test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which among the following is not an example of the 4th Generation of Computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ICL 2900**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ICL 2900 is not an example of the 4th Generation of Computers. 
 
• The ICL 2900 was released in 1966, making it a 3rd Generation Computer.
 
• Here are some of the characteristics of 4th Generation Computers:
 
 
• They use Very Large Scale Integration (VLSI) technology.
 
• They are more powerful and reliable than previous generations of computers.
 
• They are smaller and more affordable than previous generations of computers.
 
• They use high-level languages such as C and C++.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
Apple II - This is indeed an example of a fourth-generation computer. It was released by Apple Computer (now Apple Inc.) in 1977 and was one of the first highly successful mass-produced microcomputer products.

 
 
• 
 
TRS-80 - This is another example of a fourth-generation computer. It was a desktop microcomputer launched in 1977 and produced by Tandy Corporation through their Radio Shack stores.
